title: Arithmetic and ordinary integral inputs for a proper square
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite normed extension with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\square=(f:X\to Y,f':X'\to Y',g:Y'\to Y,g':X'\to X)$ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f$ proper. Assume that all four schemes are Noetherian, finite dimensional, and have $\ell$ invertible in every local ring; no linearity over a base field is required. Put $P_n=A/\varpi^n$ and $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $\mathcal I_T$ for the full three-clause integral category of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], with its compatible etale-origin witnesses. For $K\in\mathcal I_X$ use ordinary ambient ringed operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and set $C=Rf_{*,A}K$, $M=Lg_A^*C$, and $E_0=Lg_A'^*K$.
The quotient rings $P_n$ are finite with unital transitions, $\ell$ annihilates $A/(\varpi)$, $f'$ is proper, and there exists $d\geq0$ bounding the dimensions of all geometric fibres of $f$. For every edge $h:T'\to T$, the actual coefficient structure map $c_h:h^{-1}A_T\to A_{T'}$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] is an isomorphism, preserving all quotient projections and transitions. Its module pullback is exact, identifies with inverse image, and is left adjoint to module direct image.
Moreover $C\in\mathcal I_Y$, $M\in\mathcal I_{Y'}$, and $E_0\in\mathcal I_{X'}$. Each of these memberships, and the membership of $K$, agrees with membership in the stratified-perfect category of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], for the same completed coefficient sheaves and reductions. For $(h,L)=(g,C)$ and $(g',K)$ the canonical comparison $Lh_A^*L\to\widehat P_hL$ specified in [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback] is precisely the quotient-tower completion unit $\gamma_{h,L}$ of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], using the normalized tensor/pullback identifications. This statement concerns ordinary ambient inputs and their actual comparison maps; it makes no assertion about exchange.

proof.text: By [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], each quotient $P_n$ with $n\geq1$ is finite, and the quotient transitions are ring maps, hence send $1$ to $1$. By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr], applied to the spectral norm extending $|\cdot|_\ell$, $A$ is a DVR whose maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ is generated by the chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ and consists of the elements of norm $<1$. Since $|\ell|_E=|\ell|_\ell=\ell^{-1}<1$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], one has $\ell\in\mathfrak m=\varpi A$, so $\ell=0$ in $A/(\varpi)$.

proof.text: Use the assumed finite dimension of X and the existing source-library topologicalKrullDim_pullback_le for field points to bound every geometric fibre by dim X. Properness of f prime is a pullback instance under square.hom_snd.

Identify completedCoefficientMap with integralRingIso.hom by the limit projection equations. Finite transition compatibility is naturality of the constant-comparison transformation conjugated by the level comparisons. The published scalar-extension object and map equalities identify the module pullback with the exact ringed inverse image. Its adjunction is the published one. Restriction along the coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence; the scalar adjunction unit is thus invertible. Its normalized Hom formula fixes tensor-unit sections. Sectionwise extensionality proves uniqueness. The transition compatibility uses the constant comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image] and the constant-system comparison of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]; the scalar-extension witness is the change datum of [def-weil-pbc-derived-reduction-model-data].

The uniform local-model cohomology theorem supplies a common reduction interval. Exact faithful restriction from the finite coefficient presentation reflects zero homology, giving the required interval for the actual reductions. Use N=l, the residue annihilation from step 1, the geometric bound from step 2, and the assumed stalk units (global by local detection) in preservation-constructible. Its first component gives the proper direct image membership.

Restriction along the detailed coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence and therefore induces an equivalence of derived categories. Choose a preimage of each actual derived object under this equivalence. Combine the two stratified-perfect characterizations and isomorphism invariance of the uniform complete predicate to obtain all membership agreements. Apply ordinary completed integral pullback to such a preimage and transport by a.derivedIso to obtain the two ordinary pullback memberships.

Apply the ambient strict-model comparison to g and g prime. It supplies one normalized a,b independent of each input presentation. Naturality of the actual strict completed-pullback unit along each presentation isomorphism extends its identity-L equation to every L and e. Reassociate compositions to obtain both CompletionMatching clauses, and assemble the conjunction.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q03-a1dcbbfb2 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: This is the first split of the item, which Q109 created on 2026-10-22. No re-split note applies. The delivery has no new nodes and leaves the statement and stmt_deps unchanged. No cited node reaches the item or its parent, so there is no cycle. The parent lem-weil-pbc-realization-completed-mate uses this item's clauses only as inputs, so the item does not restate the parent. Sources checked in Bhatt–Scholze: Lemma 6.5.9(1)-(5), Proposition 6.6.11, Lemma 6.7.2 and Remark 6.8.15. Remark 6.8.15 gives Λ-pullback only for étale maps and closed immersions; the item instead uses the existing profinite-coefficient node, which covers every morphism and is correct for O_E (the sheaf of a profinite set). Step 1: DVR, finite quotients, and ℓ in the maximal ideal because |ℓ|_E = ℓ^{-1} (fine for ramified E and ℓ = 2); perfectness through the standard-quotients node. Step 2: finite type plus quasi-compact Y gives the hypotheses of the fin fibre-dimension bound; the field-extension dimension lemma gives the geometric fibre bound; f' is proper by permanence (b). Step 3: the profinite-lemma map c_u has the projections that define c_g, so the two agree; the module pullback, its exactness and the adjunction are as stated in the proetale-operations node. Step 4: every hypothesis of prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible holds (N = ℓ, f and f' proper, e = d, a single interval [a,b]); its Rf_* is the ordinary direct image; the characterization lemma identifies the result with the detailed category. Faults repaired, two in all. (1) C3/C4, step 5: lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback is about the ringed-topos pullback P_h, but the item's M and E_0 use Lh_A^*, and the step never identified the two. Fixed with lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback: its ε_Q, with B_W = A_W and the same c_h, gives M = P_gC and E_0 = P_{g'}K. (2) E5/C1, step 6: η of lem-tw and the descent lemma maps into the cone model Cone(1-s)[-1] through λ_Q, while γ_{h,L} of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback maps into lim I_n of the functorial K-injective tower resolution. Calling them 'the same normalization' skips a comparison of the two derived-limit models; the projection-compatible lem-a1 comparison does not pin the map. Fixed by splitting the step. New step 6: the tower is identified by balancing, using step 3, and the augmentation equals a_Q, so descent characterizes η_{h,L}. New step 7: lem-weil-derived-limit-roos-complex makes (0,ι): lim I → Cone a quasi-isomorphism; at chain level ι_I γ = Cone(r') α_Q; Cone(r') is a quasi-isomorphism by lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact; hence γ = η under that specified identification. The fix adds four proof_deps and one tool_use, the generic products-exact lemma; nothing else changes. Batch-5 flag: prop-weil-pbc-preservation-constructible reaches lem-trf-additive-homotopy-category-triangulated, the generic fact that the homotopy category of an additive category is triangulated. That is not a step of the trace formula or Poincaré duality proofs, so it is accepted. The added cites bring no new node into the item's closure. Off-unit tool uses (lem-tw-*, dimension, l-adic and p1 nodes) are accepted as generic. No SGA source is used.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
